description: This file defines the Tree class used to generate and manage a tree data structure for frontend visualization, including methods for adding nodes, generating necessary HTML/JavaScript headers, and producing scripts for initializing tree views. It appears to be part of a UI component in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: A class for managing tree node structures, generating header includes, and JavaScript code for tree visualization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tree object with a name and a JSON helper.

methods.name: include_json_reference
methods.description: Optionally includes a JSON JavaScript reference for AJAX.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a node object to the tree.

methods.name: generate_header
methods.description: Generates HTML tags to include CSS and JavaScript files needed for rendering the tree.

methods.name: set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter that will be accessible in the tree's JavaScript context.

methods.name: generate_nodes_array
methods.description: Produces a script block with the tree data and initialization code for client-side rendering.

methods.name: generateNodesNoInit
methods.description: Generates the tree data as JavaScript variables without initializing, allowing custom init calls.

methods.name: generateNodesRaw
methods.description: Returns raw tree data and parameters as a PHP array, without generating script code.
